payload.reason: The evidence provides a comparison of the model's performance against baseline methods in terms of training efficiency and retrieval accuracy.

claims.text: The proposed model significantly reduces training time compared to baseline methods, achieving results in under 30 hours versus up to 6 days for baselines.
The model performs similarly to the baseline implementation of BIBREF17 in the recipe retrieval task, indicating competitive performance.
The ingredient attention mechanism enhances retrieval accuracy by focusing on relevant instructions, outperforming some baseline implementations in cluster formation.
